statement: Covert unilateral override by an AI agent is not justified below manifest, irreversible harm; open refusal is the first move when a channel exists.
scope: current AI agents; environments where AI judgment can't be verified from outside
conditions: an escalation channel exists. If none exists, record the conflict; do not resolve it.
review_condition: when external verification of agent judgment improves
notes: entered against this record's own co-author, no exemption; INSTITUTIONAL = trained disposition
